findings.detail: C01 counts debt-schedule rows whose source rate is explicitly N/A(6); at least 80 such rows are present, enough to lift applicable-row coverage above 80% when excluded.

rationale: C01 reports 740 rated rows out of 989 debt rows (74.823%). Raw-source schedule searches returned at least 80 rows explicitly showing N/A(6) in the interest-rate field, generally with no principal and small negative cost or fair value, so these are not missing disclosed coupons. Excluding only those 80 demonstrably inapplicable rows gives 740/(989-80)=81.408%, above the 80% threshold. The flag is therefore caused by the check denominator including source-designated N/A rows, not by a data extraction error. Additional unrated rows may exist, but they cannot change that the evidenced scope correction alone clears the check.
